event: Determine the relative direction of a creak sound from an imagined robot's perspective.

sounding_object.description: The sounding object is the front door of the house. It is a light blue, arched wooden door with a floral wreath (pink flowers, green leaves, and decorative Easter eggs). It features a small, square, four-paned window and a black metal handle. Approximate size: 0.8m wide, 2m tall. The creak sound occurs as this door is being closed.

reference_object.description: A black flat-screen television, approximately 50-inch diagonal, mounted on/above a light-colored wooden TV stand/console. It is located against the wall opposite the main sofa.

facing_object.description: A tall, dark brown wooden china cabinet. It has glass doors on the upper section (displaying white and patterned china) and solid wooden doors/drawers on the lower section. It is located to the left of the main sofa (when viewed from the entrance), deeper into the living room. Approximate size: 1m wide, 2m tall.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the tv and facing the wooden china cabinet, when the creak sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
